probableCause: ConsignmentService.cancel rejects BOOKED consignments because its guard compares with '>= Status.BOOKED'. The spec only forbids cancelling from LOADED onwards, so the comparison is off by one at the boundary.
evidence: InvalidTransitionException 'Cannot cancel consignment C-101 in status BOOKED' is thrown at ConsignmentService.java:12.
The guard is 'consignment.status().ordinal() >= Status.BOOKED.ordinal()', which includes BOOKED.
docs/SPEC.md (Consignment lifecycle): a consignment can be cancelled while DRAFT or BOOKED, and not from LOADED onwards.
refusesToCancelALoadedConsignment passes, so only the boundary value BOOKED is wrong.

possibleSolutions.solution: Change the guard to a strict comparison: reject only when status.ordinal() > Status.BOOKED.ordinal().
tradeoffs: Relies on the enum order; an explicit set of cancellable statuses would be clearer but is a bigger change.

confidenceReason: The stack trace, the guard code and the spec agree on the same boundary.
limitations: No execution log was available; it is not needed for this failure.
